PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # nfet gm/Id (sets trip-point Vg)
    "Ln":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Lp":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I":      (55e-6, 25e-6, 62e-6), # inverter current
    "Rin":    (10e3, 4e3, 30e3),
    "ratio":  (12.0, 9.0, 18.0),     # Rf/Rin ideal gain
    "vout_t": (0.9, 0.7, 1.1),       # target output DC
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vo = p["vout_t"]; I = p["I"]
    Rin = p["Rin"]; Rf = p["ratio"] * Rin

    # nfet sets gate voltage at the current
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=vo)
    vg0 = mn.vgs
    # pfet: find gm/Id so that |Vgs_p| = VDD - Vg at same current
    target = VDD - vg0
    lo, hi = 3.0, 16.0
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.size("p", mid, p["Lp"], I, vds=VDD - vo).vgs > target:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    mp = lut.size("p", 0.5 * (lo + hi), p["Lp"], I, vds=VDD - vo)

    # exact trip point with forward model (vout fixed at vo)
    def f(vg):
        a = lut.op("n", mn.W, mn.L, vg, vo)["Id"]
        b = lut.op("p", mp.W, mp.L, VDD - vg, VDD - vo)["Id"]
        return a - b
    a, b = 0.3, 1.2
    for _ in range(50):
        m = 0.5 * (a + b)
        if f(m) > 0:
            b = m
        else:
            a = m
    vg = 0.5 * (a + b)
    on = lut.op("n", mn.W, mn.L, vg, vo)
    opp = lut.op("p", mp.W, mp.L, VDD - vg, VDD - vo)
    Itrip = on["Id"]

    # DC trim resistor at gate node so vout = vo
    inet = (vin - vg) / Rin + (vo - vg) / Rf
    Rb, rb_node = None, None
    if inet > 1e-9:
        Rb, rb_node = min(vg / inet, 1e9), "vss"
    elif inet < -1e-9:
        Rb, rb_node = min((VDD - vg) / (-inet), 1e9), "vdd"

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    mfn = max(1, int(math.ceil(mn.W / 20.0)))
    mfp = max(1, int(math.ceil(mp.W / 20.0)))
    n.dev("MN", "vout", "vg", "vss", "vss", mn, m=mfn)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp, m=mfp)
    n.R("RIN", "vin", "vg", Rin)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "vg", Rf)
    if Rb is not None:
        n.R("RB", "vg", rb_node, Rb)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.9)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)   # absorbs IREF

    # predictions
    gm = on["gm"] + opp["gm"]
    Rp = Rin if Rb is None else Rin * Rb / (Rin + Rb)
    go = on["gds"] + opp["gds"] + 1.0 / (Rf + Rp)
    A0 = gm / go
    beta = Rp / (Rp + Rf)
    T0 = A0 * beta
    Acl = (Rf / Rin) * T0 / (1 + T0)
    cout = cl + mn.cdd + mp.cdd
    f1 = go * (1 + T0) / (2 * PI * cout)
    cf = mn.cgd + mp.cgd
    f2 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rf * max(cf, 1e-16))
    f3 = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1 / f1**2 + 1 / f2**2)
    power = VDD * (Itrip + iref)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(Acl), "f3db": f3, "gbw": Acl * f3,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vo, "swing": 1.55}

events.topology: Self-biased CMOS inverter (current-reuse CS, nfet+pfet both driven) with resistive shunt feedback Rf/Rin plus a DC-trim resistor Rb
